description: What is the standard name and ID for this medicine? Matches a messy drug name, brand, or name-plus-strength (e.g. 'zocor 10mg', 'metformin 500') to the closest US RxNorm concepts and their RxCUI codes, best match first, from the U.S. National Library of Medicine RxNav approximate-match service. Useful as the first step for medication lists, reconciliation and any tool that needs an RxCUI. Matches are ranked by text similarity, not checked clinically; only RxNorm-source names are returned, and non-US brand names may not match. (cost: 1 credit)

limit.description: integer, optional, 1-10 matches to return, default 5

term.description: string, required, the drug name as written, optionally with strength or form (e.g. "zocor 10 mg")

name: drug_name_match
